---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page of the Crumb & Co. home bakery website.
---

1. The brand name is "Crumb & Co." and the tagline is "Baked fresh in Lahore, every morning." Show both in the header of every page.
2. Tone of voice is warm, friendly and short. Use simple English with no slang.
3. Colours: page background #FFF8F0, main text #3B2A20, buttons and links #C0522B, highlights #E9B872. Use no other colours.
4. Fonts: headings in "Playfair Display" and body text in "Poppins", both loaded from Google Fonts.
5. Every page must have a header with the brand name and navigation links to Home (index.html) and About (about.html), and a footer reading "© 2026 Crumb & Co. · Lahore · 0300-1234567".
6. Write prices as "Rs 1,250": always "Rs", a space, and commas for thousands, with no decimals.
7. Write dates as "Sat, 12 Dec 2026" and times as "4:00 pm".
8. Show menu items as cards in a grid. Each card has an emoji, the item name, a one-line description and the price.
9. Every order or contact form must check that the phone number is exactly 11 digits starting with 03, and show a friendly error in #C0522B if it is not.
10. Every page must work on mobile, switching to a single column below 700px wide.
11. Use plain
